card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 7 That Restarts When You Make A Call

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 7 That Restarts When You Make A Call

claims.statement: An iPhone 7 that reboots as a call starts usually has corrosion on the front camera flex's ALS/proximity sensor; unplug the front camera flex to confirm, then replace or clean it.

procedure: Unplug the front camera flex and test a call.
Fit a new front camera flex, or clean corrosion with IPA.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
